title: Why?
body: Why aren’t you saying openly this version is limited to only 3 habits ?
author: Michidutza

title: Needs some improvements
body: That’s a wonderful and smart app, with many useful templates. But what bothers me is the inflexibility of time interval between occurrences (for example, a goal at every x days/weekdays/months or a goal at a certain weekday / day in month). If you add that, I’ll be your subscriber.
author: Bogdan Hutanu

title: Good at keeping track of anything
body: I used it to break or make habits, track weight and it's great.
author: Denisacdi

title: It's helpful
body: And easy to use. I like the visuals and the fact that I can check with an easy left or right swipe. The only thing is that sometimes it doesn't update imediatly when I change an entrance, but then I go to calendar and update there, so it's ok. Thanks!
author: Pisicaham

title: Amazing app
body: Really amazing, easy to use, nice design and everything to need in one app
author: Cosmin Tronaru
